title: LiveLayer · Every event smarter than the last
description: LiveLayer shows festivals and event organisers where queues cost sales and where capacity stood empty – and gives them a plan in kroner for next time.

hero.sub: LiveLayer shows where queues cost sales and where capacity stood empty – and gives you a plan in kroner for next time. For festivals, venues and event agencies.

statement: A festival makes its money on a handful of nights. That is where the bars have to fit the crowd.

steps.d: A festival runs for a few days a year. That leaves a few hours to try something new – and a whole year before the answer comes. So most decisions are made on gut feeling.

steps.t: Relay learns from you, year after year.
steps.d: Every season becomes part of your festival’s memory: what you tried, what it gave, and what you changed the year after. The lessons build on each other instead of disappearing when the rota is packed away.

steps.t: And from other festivals – adapted to you.
steps.d: Every festival is described in the same festival model: bars, zones, programme, crowd and hours. So Relay can model another festival’s lesson into your context – your size, site and programme. Personal data is deleted. The lessons stay.

steps.t: Into ranges you can act on.
steps.d: Many factors are in play: ticket sales, programme, weather, site and the other vendors. We give a range based on data – and put your own decision margin on top, say 12.5 %, so the recommendation fits the risk you want to take.

margin.f: Ticket sales · programme · weather · site · the other vendors

who.d: A few days and big sums. Learn from every hour – and from the other festivals.
Many nights a year. Every night becomes a test the next one can build on.
Many events and formats. The lessons travel from one to the next.

layer.h2: A layer of numbers over the festival.
layer.p: We lay your sales on top of the site, hour by hour and bar by bar. So you can see what you only sense today: where people gave up on the queue, and where volunteers stood waiting.
layer.alt: Guests queueing at a food truck

night.p: Scroll through a Friday at a festival with seven bars.
night.alt: The festival site from the air in the evening
night.empty: Hours of capacity with no guests
captions: The gates open. Four bars are ready – but the guests have not arrived yet.
People pour in. Capacity fits almost everywhere.
First queue: the food street. Meanwhile the entrance bar stands idle.
The VIP bar empties. Volunteers and terminals wait.
The headliner comes on. The queue in the tent grows to 14 minutes.
Queues in the tent and at stage 2 at once. Every hour costs bar 4 about DKK 16,000.
The concert ends. The crowd moves to the main stage.
The after-party in the camping area. That is where the queue is now.
The last hours. Several bars stand with capacity and no guests.
Friday in total: DKK 106,000 in sales that walked away, and 27 hours of capacity with no guests.

items.name: Insight
items.q: What happened – and what did it cost?
items.text: Every bar and every hour of your last event: where queues cost sales, and where capacity stood empty. In kroner.

items.name: Plan
items.q: What do we do differently next time?
items.text: Concrete recommendations on bars, payment terminals, staffing and vendor volumes. Each with its value in kroner.

changes.lead: You and your vendors no longer have to guess how much food and drink to bring. Every vendor gets a range for every day – with the reasoning behind it, so everyone can see exactly why we recommend it.
changes.note: The estimates hang together: when the pizza truck gets more ovens, the burger stand sells fewer burgers. So we calculate the whole festival at once – not one vendor at a time.

others.d: More where the queues will be. Fewer where they won’t – with the same number of shifts.
More payment terminals where the queues were. Fewer where capacity stood empty.
Every change has its value in kroner before the budget is set.

partner.h2: Right now we take on 4⁠–⁠5 partners. Free.
partner.p: Festivals, venues and event agencies. You get Insight and Plan. We get your honest feedback.
